svg.title: Dynamis Group
svg.desc: Dynamis Group. Engineering. Advisory. Applied Research. Dynamis Group is a tiered digital firm in Melbourne. We engineer software, advise on systems, and run a small R&D lab — for Australian operators who value precision.
